candidates.description: A standardized scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value associated with 'ECOG performance status' or 'ECOG'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale, where 0 represents fully active and 4 represents completely disabled.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: It is uncertain if the reported status is baseline or at the time of a specific follow-up encounter across different notes.

candidates.description: The percentage of viable tumor cells showing partial or complete membrane staining for PD-L1 using the 22C3 assay.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate 'PD-L1 (22C3)' in pathology reports and extract the numerical percentage associated with the 'Tumor proportion score'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Percentage (%) of tumor cells positive for PD-L1 expression.
candidates.name: PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score (TPS)
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence does not specify if these scores were calculated from the primary tumor or metastatic sites in all cases.

limitations: Small number of patients represented in the snippets.
Heterogeneity in the timing of the documented ECOG status (baseline vs. progress notes).
summary: The evidence contains baseline clinical and pathological data for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including functional performance status and PD-L1 expression levels.
